items.title: Uber Technologies (UBER) Lands Licensed Autonomous Rides In London With 100,000 Sign Ups
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) plans to launch licensed autonomous rides in London in partnership with AI startup Wayve, marking its first such deployment in a major global city. The London service will use a hybrid model that pairs AI-driven vehicles with safety certified human drivers to meet local regulatory requirements. More than 100,000 London residents have joined a sign-up list for the service, highlighting strong public interest in Uber's autonomous offering. The move positions Uber...

items.title: Serve Robotics Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Serve Robotics (NASDAQ:SERV) reported second-quarter revenue growth but sharply reduced its full-year outlook after delivery volume through Uber declined for the first time in 17 quarters, prompting the company to reassess the future of the partnership and redirect resources toward other channels.
